password.description: Current account password, to prove possession before setting a PIN.

username.description: 3-20 chars of [a-z0-9_]; case-insensitive (stored lower-case) and unique.

Currency.description: Currencies the user can receive in (active wallets)

wallets.description: Currencies the user can receive in (active wallets)

displayName.description: First name and last initial, e.g. "Ali K."

amount.description: Decimal string in major units, e.g. "1250.50"

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units as a string, e.g. "125050"

documentRef.description: Reference to an uploaded document image in object storage.

balance.description: Cached balance on the account's normal side
Cached balance on the account's normal side

reason.description: Why the entry is being reversed (kept on the reversal entry for audit).

sellAmount.description: Amount of `fromCurrency` to convert (fee is charged on top).

bps.description: Percentage part in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%)

displayName.description: Privacy-preserving name, e.g. "Ali K." for users or the business name for merchants

received.description: Cross-currency payments: what the payee received

amount.description: Amount sent, in the payer's currency

fee.description: Fee charged to the payer (payer's currency)

amount.description: Decimal string; its currency is the source wallet's (SEND) or `toCurrency` (RECEIVE).

customerRate.description: Rate applied to the customer (mid less spread), 8 decimal places

amount.description: Fixed amount (single-use, expires). Omit for a reusable "pay me any amount" code.

payload.description: The opaque payload exactly as scanned (PC1.<claims>.<signature>)

amount.description: null: the payer enters the amount

fee.description: Fee charged to the payer (null when the amount is payer-entered; see GET /fees)

expiresAt.description: When the QR itself expires (null = reusable static code)

previewToken.description: From POST /qr/resolve (short-lived, single use, bound to you, the payee, the amount and the fee)

amount.description: Required when the preview amount is null (payer-entered amount); must match otherwise.

category.description: ISO 18245 merchant category code, 4 digits (e.g. 5812 restaurants)

pendingSettlement.description: Unsettled net balance owed to the merchant

reference.description: Your order/invoice reference, shown to the payer and in reports

received.description: Cross-currency payments: what the payee received

amount.description: Amount sent, in the payer's currency

fee.description: Fee charged to the payer (payer's currency)

amount.description: Defaults to the full remaining refundable amount

reference.description: Quote this reference in the transfer so the bank can match it

bankAmount.description: Net movement per the bank statement (+ in / - out)

ledgerAmount.description: Net movement on BANK_CLEARING per the ledger

settlementId.description: Extension: resolve a merchant settlement payout instead (SUCCEEDED -> PAID)

delayMs.description: Deliver the webhook later (processed by the outbox relay / worker)

delivered.description: false when delayMs > 0: the webhook is sent later by the worker

status.description: Payment / funding status, or COMPLETED for plain ledger entries
